dishes.name: Spicy Miso Ramen
dishes.description: Rich pork broth blended with white miso and house chili oil, topped with slow-braised pork belly and a jammy egg.
dishes.preparation: Broth simmered for 12 hours; pork belly braised in soy and mirin, then torched before serving.

dishes.name: Dan Dan Noodles
dishes.description: Sichuan-style noodles in a numbing, spicy sesame sauce with crispy minced pork and crushed peanuts.
dishes.preparation: Pork stir-fried until crisp; noodles boiled and tossed with the sauce at the table.

dishes.name: Mushroom Shoyu Ramen
dishes.description: A clear, savory shiitake and kombu broth seasoned with soy sauce, with roasted tofu and bamboo shoots.
dishes.preparation: Dashi steeped cold overnight, then gently warmed; tofu roasted until golden.

dishes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
dishes.description: Wok-fried rice with aged kimchi, gochujang and crispy pork belly, crowned with a fried egg.
dishes.preparation: Day-old rice fried at high heat in a wok with kimchi and gochujang.

dishes.name: Green Curry with Tofu
dishes.description: Fragrant Thai green curry with coconut milk, tofu, Thai eggplant and basil, served with jasmine rice.
dishes.preparation: Curry paste fried in coconut cream before simmering with vegetables and tofu.

dishes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
dishes.description: Yogurt-marinated chicken charred in the tandoor and finished in a creamy, mildly spiced tomato sauce.
dishes.preparation: Chicken marinated for 24 hours, cooked in a tandoor oven, then simmered in the sauce.

dishes.name: Chana Masala
dishes.description: Chickpeas slow-cooked in a tangy, spicy tomato and onion gravy, served with basmati rice.
dishes.preparation: Whole spices tempered in oil, then simmered with chickpeas for two hours.

dishes.name: Grilled Lamb Kofta
dishes.description: Spiced lamb skewers grilled over charcoal with tahini sauce, sumac onions and warm flatbread.
dishes.preparation: Hand-shaped skewers grilled over charcoal.

dishes.name: Falafel Plate
dishes.description: Crispy herb falafel with hummus, tabbouleh, pickled turnips and pita.
dishes.preparation: Falafel made from soaked raw chickpeas and deep-fried to order.

dishes.name: Beer-Battered Fish Tacos
dishes.description: Crispy beer-battered cod in corn tortillas with chipotle mayo and lime cabbage slaw.
dishes.preparation: Cod battered and deep-fried to order.

dishes.name: Beef Birria Tacos
dishes.description: Beef braised with guajillo and ancho chilies, folded into crisped corn tortillas with a cup of consommé for dipping.
dishes.preparation: Beef braised for six hours; tortillas dipped in the braising fat and griddled.

dishes.name: Elote
dishes.description: Charred street corn brushed with mayonnaise, rolled in cotija cheese and dusted with chili and lime.
dishes.preparation: Corn grilled over open flame, then dressed to order.

dishes.name: Margherita Pizza
dishes.description: Wood-fired pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil.
dishes.preparation: Dough fermented for 48 hours, baked for 90 seconds in a wood-fired oven.

dishes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
dishes.description: Spaghetti tossed with crispy guanciale, egg yolk, pecorino romano and plenty of black pepper.
dishes.preparation: Sauce emulsified off the heat with pasta water; no cream.

dishes.name: Walnut Pesto Gnocchi
dishes.description: Pan-seared potato gnocchi with basil and walnut pesto and blistered cherry tomatoes.
dishes.preparation: Gnocchi made in house, boiled, then seared in olive oil.

dishes.name: Wild Mushroom Risotto
dishes.description: Creamy arborio risotto with porcini and cremini mushrooms, finished with butter and hard cheese.
dishes.preparation: Rice toasted, deglazed with white wine and stirred with stock for 18 minutes.

dishes.name: Grilled Salmon with Lemon-Dill Butter
dishes.description: Salmon fillet grilled skin-side down, with lemon-dill butter, roasted potatoes and asparagus.
dishes.preparation: Grilled to medium; butter melted over the fish at the pass.

dishes.name: Garlic Chili Prawns
dishes.description: Prawns sizzled in garlic butter with chili flakes and parsley, served with sourdough to mop up the sauce.
dishes.preparation: Cooked in a cast-iron pan and served still sizzling.

dishes.name: Green Papaya Salad
dishes.description: Shredded green papaya pounded with chili, lime, fish sauce, dried shrimp and peanuts.
dishes.preparation: Pounded to order in a clay mortar.

dishes.name: Salted Edamame
dishes.description: Steamed young soybeans in the pod, finished with flaky sea salt.
dishes.preparation: Steamed to order.

dishes.name: Pork Gyoza
dishes.description: Pan-fried dumplings filled with pork, cabbage and ginger, with a soy and rice vinegar dipping sauce.
dishes.preparation: Folded by hand; pan-fried then steamed for a crisp base.

dishes.name: Caesar Salad
dishes.description: Crisp romaine with anchovy-garlic dressing, sourdough croutons and shaved parmesan.
ingredients: caesar dressing (egg yolk, anchovy, dijon mustard)
dishes.preparation: Dressing emulsified in house daily.

dishes.name: Tiramisu
dishes.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa.
dishes.preparation: Assembled the day before and chilled overnight.

dishes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
dishes.description: Sweet glutinous rice soaked in salted coconut cream, served with ripe mango and toasted sesame.
dishes.preparation: Rice steamed, then soaked in warm sweetened coconut milk.

dishes.name: Flourless Chocolate Cake
dishes.description: Dense, fudgy dark chocolate cake made with almond flour, served with whipped cream.
dishes.preparation: Baked in a water bath and rested for a dense texture.
